solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reconstruct-original-digits-from-english/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

423. Reconstruct Original Digits from English

Given a string s containing an out-of-order English representation of digits 0-9, return the digits in ascending order.

Example 1:

Input: s = "owoztneoer"
Output: "012"

Example 2:

Input: s = "fviefuro"
Output: "45"

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 10^5
    s[i] is one of the characters ["e","g","f","i","h","o","n","s","r","u","t","w","v","x","z"].
    s is guaranteed to be valid.
"""


class Solution:
    def originalDigits(self, s: str) -> str:
        count = Counter(s)
        out = {}

        # Unique letters for certain digits
        out["0"] = count["z"]  # zero
        out["2"] = count["w"]  # two
        out["4"] = count["u"]  # four
        out["6"] = count["x"]  # six
        out["8"] = count["g"]  # eight

        # Letters that appear in multiple digits
        out["3"] = count["h"] - out["8"]  # three (h is in eight and three)
        out["5"] = count["f"] - out["4"]  # five (f is in four and five)
        out["7"] = count["s"] - out["6"]  # seven (s is in six and seven)

        # For digits 1 and 9
        out["1"] = (
            count["o"] - out["0"] - out["2"] - out["4"]
        )  # one (o is in zero, one, two, four)
        out["9"] = (
            count["i"] - out["5"] - out["6"] - out["8"]
        )  # nine (i is in five, six, eight, nine)

        # Build the output string
        result = []
        for digit in sorted(out.keys()):
            result.append(digit * out[digit])
        return "".join(result)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.originalDigits("owoztneoer"))  # "012"

assert sol.originalDigits("owoztneoer") == "012"
assert sol.originalDigits("fviefuro") == "45"

assert sol.originalDigits("zerozerozero") == "000"
assert sol.originalDigits("nineninenine") == "999"
assert sol.originalDigits("onetwothreefourfivesixseveneightnine") == "123456789"
assert sol.originalDigits("zzzzwwwwuuuu") == "0000222244449999"
assert sol.originalDigits("xgxgxgxg") == "66668888"
assert sol.originalDigits("eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee") == ""
assert sol.originalDigits("fviefurofviefurofviefuro") == "444555"
assert sol.originalDigits("onetwoonetwoonetwo") == "111222"
assert sol.originalDigits("sseveennninee") == "779"
assert sol.originalDigits("o") == "1"
assert sol.originalDigits("z") == "0"
assert sol.originalDigits("n") == ""
